How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your Theradome helmet properly for the first time is straightforward:
1. Charge First: Plug your helmet into the wall charger until it is fully charged.
2. Prepare Your Scalp & Hair: Ensure your scalp is clean and dry. Avoid applying heavy styling gels, sprays, or alcohol-based hair products before your treatment, as these can block the laser light from reaching your scalp.
